October 2026 · Issue 14
Three things we did this month
Thank you for standing with us. Here is a short account of where your support went in October, and one way you can help in November.
Food bank relaunched
A new team of twelve volunteers now runs Saturday collections. Fresh produce is sorted the same day.
Youth coding nights
Every Thursday at the library. Laptops are provided; places for the next term open on 4 November.

One thing you can help with
Riverside Park needs 40 volunteers on Saturday 15 November for the winter planting. Two hours, tools and hot drinks provided, all ages welcome.
